justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjector.java` (UsingReflection, lines 210-1593) is a very large nested class with 3 constructors plus `injectRaw`, `isAlive`, `isAvailable`, `ofSystemClassLoader`, and a helper `doPrivileged`, and it embeds a dispatcher hierarchy (`Dispatcher`, `Initializable`, `Direct`, `ForJava7CapableVm`, `ForLegacyVm`, `UsingUnsafeInjection`, `UsingUnsafeOverride`, `Unavailable`, `System`) covering direct reflection, unsafe-based injection, package-definition fallback, and security-manager handling. `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjectorUsingReflectionTest.java` exercises these separate modes (direct, unsafe, unsafe override, legacy, unavailable), which is strong evidence of multiple separable responsibilities and insufficient modularization.
